{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
# Only completed orders that are not QA are valid for revenue calculation
df_valid = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_valid.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print results
print("Total revenue by channel (after filtering QA and refunded):")
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with the most revenue
most_revenue_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.index[0]
print(f"\nChannel with the most revenue: {most_revenue_channel}")"}
